About Us
KAD Import & Export PLC is an Ethiopian international trading company specializing in the export of agricultural commodities and the import of industrial, construction, and commercial products.
We provide reliable sourcing, procurement, logistics, customs clearance, and global trade solutions for partners in Ethiopia and worldwide.

article.p: To connect Ethiopian products with international markets while supplying high-quality imported goods that support growth, industry, and long-term partnerships.
To become one of East Africa’s most trusted import and export companies, recognized for reliability, quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction.
Integrity, quality assurance, on-time delivery, competitive pricing, and responsible sourcing across every trade we manage.
